text.content:
A 10-minute in-Foundry smoke test that exercises every activity on all five actors (plus both magic items) by actually rolling them. If every box checks out, the compendium data is behaving exactly as documented — no JSON reading required.

Setup (1 minute): import the five actors from the New Ragnarok Reborn — NPCs compendium into a blank scene, drag the Cloak of Shadows and Amulet of the Night from the loot pack onto any player token, and enable GM eye so you can see every chat card.

How to read the table: each row is one click on an actor sheet. The Should show column is what the chat card must display. Any mismatch — wrong bonus, wrong dice, missing effect, empty recharge — is a data bug: note it and compare against the release's check-actor-fixes.py output before reporting.

Budget: 3 min for the Ewoks, 4 min for Umbrathor, 3 min for Vorath. Empty checkbox = untested.

#ActivityRollShould show
1Ewoklin — ClawsAttack roll+7 to hit; 2d6+4 slashing
2Ewoklin — Primitive WeaponMelee Attack roll+7; 2d8+4 piercing
3Ewoklin — Primitive WeaponThrown (20/60) roll+7; 2d8+4 piercing
4Ewoklin — Mischievous SurgeFey Chaos — DC 15 WIS save6d6 psychic on fail, half on success; random rider on fail
5Ewoklin — Evasive ScamperScamper (utility)no roll — free reposition without opportunity attacks
6Ewoklin — Multiplicity (1/Day)Split into Ewoklingspick 1–4; that many real Ewokling tokens spawn from the compendium
7Ewokling — ClawsAttack roll+5; 1d6+2 slashing
8Ewokling — Primitive SpearMelee Attack roll+5; 1d6+2 piercing
9Ewokling — Primitive SpearThrown (20/60) roll+5; 1d6+2 piercing
10Ewokling — Mischievous SparkFey Spark — DC 13 WIS save2d6 psychic on fail, half on success; Laughter on fail
11Ewokling — Evasive Tumble (1/Day)Tumble (utility)no roll — disengage-style reposition

Surge riders (row 4) — a failed save applies one random effect for 1 minute; roll it three times if you can spare the clicks:

  • Laughter — target gains incapacitated (status icon visible)
  • Fear of Technology — no icon; refusal flavor only (state it aloud)
  • Battle Fury — attack rolls improve by 2, AC reduced by 2 while active

Recharge chips: Surge recharges on 5–6, Spark on 6 — verify the little die badge on the item appears after a short-rest recovery or a manual recharge.

#ActivityRollShould show
12Dark BoltAttack roll+12; 8d8 necrotic (6d8 on the Level 8 copy)
13Terrifying PresenceFear Save — DC 20 WISfrightened 1 minute on fail
14Shadow GraspGrasp Save — DC 20 STRrestrained + 3d8 necrotic (CR 18 copy)
15Nightmare Visions (2 Actions)Nightmare Save — DC 20 WIS8d8 psychic; stunned on fail (CR 18 copy only)
16Summon Shadows (1/Encounter)Summon 1d4 Shadows1–4 official dnd5e Shadow tokens spawn
17Shadow StepTeleportno roll — teleports to a point in dim light/darkness
18Dark PactDark Pact Healingheals 1d8+6 (1d6+5 Level 8); description adds bonus healing in darkness
19Dark RejuvenationRejuvenateheals 1d8 (1d6 Level 8) — no other card effects
#Lair actionRollShould show
20Lair — Shadow FloodDC 20 CON saveno damage — darkness closes in (scene effect)
21Lair — Shadow TendrilsDC 20 DEX save4d8 necrotic, half on success (Level 8: 3d8)
22Lair — Creeping ChillDC 20 CON save2d10 cold, half on success (Level 8: 2d8)
23Lair — Shadow GraspDC 20 STR save3d8 necrotic + restrained on fail
24Lair — Shadow StepUtilityno roll — repositions

Level 8 vs CR 18: the Level 8 copy has no Nightmare Visions and smaller dice everywhere (rows show both where they differ). Test whichever you imported; the parenthetical values cover the other one. The Level 8 copy's attack is +9 and every one of its saves is DC 18 (vs the CR 18 copy's +12 / DC 20).

Dark Bolt on-hit: a hit should apply Max HP Reduced to the target (effect appears on the victim's sheet; hp.max drops). Check row 12's target after the hit.

Lair actions: enable the lair from the Lair Actions (Shadow Cavern) item (initiative 20), or just roll each activity manually from the item — manual rolls are enough for this checklist.

#ActivityRollShould show
25Shadow ForkAttack roll+10; 4d8+4 necrotic
26Necrotic GraspAttack roll+12; 8d6 necrotic; on hit applies Max HP Reduced
27Necrotic GraspMax HP Drain — DC 20 CON savesecondary save activity on the same item
28Dark Burst (Recharge 5–6)Dark Burst — DC 20 DEX save10d8 necrotic, half on success; blinded on fail; recharges 5–6
29Eldritch BlastCast — attack roll+12 to hit (flat, exactly as printed); 1d10 force per beam
30Eldritch Blastbeam countone extra beam per 2 spell-caster levels beyond the first — set the level on the cast dialog and confirm the card rolls the right number of beams
31CloudkillCast (utility)no roll — consumes a slot and starts concentration only; the cloud does the damage
32CloudkillEnter / Start of Turn — DC 20 CON save5d8 poison, half on success
33Dominate PersonCast — DC 20 WIS savecharmed 1 minute on fail; consumes a slot
34Aura of DespairDespair Save — DC 20 WIS3d6 psychic + frightened on fail
35Dreadful GazeGaze Save — DC 20 WISparalyzed on fail
36Horrifying Visage (Costs 2 Actions)Visage Save — DC 20 WISfrightened on fail
37Legendary Resistance (2/Day)Persevere (utility)no roll — auto-success counter decrements
38Animate DeadRaise Zombieone official dnd5e Zombie spawns
39Dark Pact HealingHealheals 1d8+6
40Legendary: Cast a SpellCast Eldritch Blastsame flat +12 card as row 29
41Legendary: Shadow TeleportationTeleportno roll
#Lair actionRollShould show
42Lair — Hellfire BoltAttack roll+12; 3d10 fire (plus the 6d10 rider vs frightened targets, per the description text)
43Lair — Gates of DreadDC 20 WIS savefrightened on fail
44Lair — Ember StormDC 20 DEX save2d10 fire, half on success
45Lair — Throne of ChainsDC 20 STR saverestrained on fail
46Lair — Shadow StepUtilityno roll

Spell DCs are flat 20 — every save Vorath forces shows DC 20 in the chat card regardless of his abilities. If a card shows a computed DC, that's the pre-1.3.2 bug: re-import the actor.

Legendary actions (rows 40–41) appear under the actor's legendary actions bar; rows 40–41 can be rolled from the items directly if you don't want to drive the action economy.

Lair actions: enable from Lair Actions (Hellheim Throne Room) (initiative 20) or roll manually as above.

CheckPass condition
ARecharge countersafter Surge/Spark/Dark Burst, the item shows its recharge die (5–6 / 6 / 5–6) and comes back after a rest or manual recharge
BDuration chipsfailed riders (frightened, charmed, paralyzed, restrained, stunned, incapacitated) show status icons and expire after their 1-minute duration
CConcentrationCloudkill's Cast marks Vorath concentrating; a second concentration spell prompts to drop it
DLegendary actionsVorath's legendary action counter is visible and spends on rows 40–41
ECloak of Shadowsdragged item applies its effect to the wearer: advantage on Stealth checks
FAmulet of the Nightweapon attacks gain a necrotic rider — 1d6 on the standalone item (1d4 on the CR 13 embedded copy, matching its own text)
GSummonsevery spawned token (Ewoklings, Shadows, Zombie) has a working sheet with its own attacks — click one attack to confirm
HDeath housekeeping0 HP shows defeated; Dark Pact healing at 0 HP revives him conscious

Verdict: 46/46 activity rows and A–H all checked with zero surprises — the pack is table-ready. Any mismatch: note the row, then run python3 tools/check-actor-fixes.py --verify <exported-actor.json> against the release's snapshot to pinpoint which value drifted, and compare with the changelog to see when it broke.

This checklist is generated from the same data the CI gate asserts — its expected values cannot silently drift from the actors.
